def: Uthai, the name of two Israelites

occurrences.text: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.
Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
